children: The South African rand could weaken in the near term before recovering next year, Commerzbank's Volkmar Baur says in a note. "Weak growth, political uncertainty and inflation risks related to the Iran conflict and El Nino are likely to weigh on the currency initially," he says, noting South Africa will hold municipal elections on November 4. From the second quarter of 2027, however, the outlook could improve as inflation declines, growth improves and political reforms are implemented, he says. The dollar falls 0.3% to 16.4337 rand. (renae.dyer@wsj.com)
